name: levy_1v1_sensible
description: The scripted sensible player (design bible §4, §10): from the spawn, walk toward the Corridor A levy, lock on, stop and let it come. It reacts to each levy windup (enemy_melee_telegraph) about 0.27 s after the tell starts (16 frames) by dodging back, meets the levy with a three-hit light combo as it closes again, dodges its next windup the same way, and finishes it with a fourth light hit as it closes. It models a skilled player: it dodges every swing, so its HP cost is 0%, the skilled ceiling, and enc_first_fight_hp_cost (a reasonable player, design bible §4) isn't checked here. Nothing else in Level 1 is close enough to engage.

checks.pending: clip contact frames and hitboxes synced to them (design bible §3); until then the value is hitbox open minus press
